adaptation_decisions.decision: Retain selected pins. Review of names, gitlinks and selected build/runtime changes finds macOS workflow/account/toolchain work, graphics/CPU/RamBlock selections, texture policy and Bluetooth discovery tracing. The full 301-file history was not line-by-line audited or rebased to Darwin 22.

Select public portable transport source at c888efd3ce1b817d13f28783a77cf689cb2255c9 independently of the existing driver pin. Reconcile CPH2653 six-rail supply topology, GPIOs, register windows, IOMMU selection and 128 PHY writes. Add quiesced cache clearing/release. Exclude iPad network frontend, Apple80211 binary bindings and Linux wireless runtime. Native archive and eight synthetic protocol/sequence/lifetime suites are checked separately.

Reference main now integrates Linux wireless, supplicant authentication, lifecycle/ownership and packet metadata outside DMA memory. Source preparation/macOS build changes do not establish iPhone16 ABI or target DMA/MSI ownership. Runtime source not imported by this change.

Carrier identity/configuration, PDP/reconnect and CommCenter compatibility are available upstream. Current reference is SC7180/Coachz with newer original OS inputs; SM8750 firmware/transport and exact iPhone16 interfaces remain required. No foreign board addresses or iPad binary bindings imported.
Observed selected remote tips unchanged from the prior review. Preserve current source pins and existing reviewed backports.

scope: Eight selected branch references checked by git ls-remote and selected source reviewed from immutable fetched objects in ignored review repositories. This scoped follow-up supplements the earlier 32-repository report; it does not refresh all 32 repositories or claim complete source migration.
